paragraphs.text: Atemsis , All-Seeing is a legendary Sphinx from an unknown plane introduced in Core Set 2020 .

Atemsis is a sphinx from an unknown plane. They have a purple body, a feminine face, and a crown of silver. Their wings are as large as their body with blue features and blue eye symbols glowing on them. They have been quoted as saying “That’s enough of that.” while casting Djinn back into their lamp.
